app.name: DesktopBuddy
panel.title: Your duck
bag.title: Bag
points.hint: Earn points by clicking, petting and throwing your duck
sign.title: Time for a break!
sign.body: Look out of the window and find some grass. 🌱
talk.title: Tell me what's wrong
talk.hint: Explain it to me one line at a time. Nothing is saved or sent: it's gone when you close this.
talk.reply.2: What did you expect it to do instead?
talk.reply.3: Interesting. Read me that line again, slowly.
talk.reply.5: What changed since it last worked?
talk.reply.6: Are you sure what's really in that variable?
talk.reply.7: I see. And how does that make the code feel?
talk.reply.8: Let's go back a step. Where does it start?
bag.locked: Not found yet: try the Store
bag.smokeHint: Fills with each cigar and clears by itself in a few hours.
bag.smokeFull: Needs fresh air: no cigars for {time}.
store.note: Odds are exact. Duplicates pay half the price back.
quests.reset: Daily quests change at midnight, weekly ones on Monday.
today.noApps: App names aren't recorded yet, only when you were active or away. Focus time needs app names.
today.categoryHint: Click to change: focus → distraction → neutral
today.exported: Saved a copy of your activity.
today.optin.title: Track your day? (off until you say yes)
today.optin.what: Once a minute: whether you were active or away, and which app was in front (its program name).
today.optin.never: Never window titles, web addresses, keystrokes or screenshots.
today.optin.local: It stays on this computer. Nothing is ever sent anywhere.
today.optin.control: Turn it off, hide an app, export or erase everything, any time.
focus.title: Focus session
focus.hint: The duck keeps time. Finish it for points.
stats.chart: Active and focus time over the last 7 days
stats.streakRule: A day counts for the streak with 30 min of focus or one finished focus session.
today.optin.whatNoApps: Once a minute: whether you were active or away. (Which app was in front isn't recorded in this version.)
settings.soundsHint: Quacks, chomps and chirps, made in code.
settings.welcomeBack: says hello when you come back
settings.names.hint: Kept on this PC only. The duck greets you after the PC was locked or asleep for 10 minutes or more, never over fullscreen apps.
settings.weather.notFound: City not found: try its name in English or your language.
settings.weather.offline: Couldn't reach the weather service; trying again in an hour.
settings.weather.hint: Off when empty. With a city, once an hour the duck asks Open-Meteo (free, no account) for the weather there: only the city name and its rough position are sent. With rain or snow it brings its umbrella.
settings.breaks.every: After this long at the PC
settings.breaks.hint: The duck pops up with a sign when it's time to rest your eyes and stretch. Only your idle time is used (no keys, no apps). It never shows over fullscreen games, videos or presentations, and a coffee or a cigar calms it for 30 minutes.
updates.title: Updates
updates.ready: Version {version} is ready. Your points and items are kept.
updates.error: Couldn't reach GitHub. Check your connection and try again.
updates.hint: Only asks GitHub for the newest version number; nothing about you is sent. Your saves are backed up before a new version first runs.
settings.dangerHint: Everything is stored only on this computer. Export makes a JSON copy; erase deletes points, items, quests, activity and settings, then restarts.
settings.about: DesktopBuddy {version} · open source · no telemetry · online only for updates and, if you add a city, the weather
screen.noApps: No app names for this day.
screen.off: Tracking is off. Turn it on in Today to see your screen time.
today.activeOff: With tracking on, time at the PC earns a few points too.
hunger.hungry: My tummy says it's dinner time! 🥖
hunger.hungry.named: {you}, my tummy says it's dinner time! 🥖
